title: Three Months and One Short Beam
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：wall　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wall 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the builder ① built the wall that no assistant in the site would have measured, and he said the building was the whole of the month. The ② wall, meaning the barrier itself and not the beam, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; a wall, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ wall in that site had the same short beam beside it, and the ④ wall at the far wall, meaning the brick they kept for the children to lay and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A wall, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the builder said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the wall was the whole of the matter, meaning the protection and not the barrier. The ⑥ wall, meaning the protection and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; wall, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a barrier and a protection. He said the protection is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ wall had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short beam. The ⑧ wall of the whole thing, the builder wrote in October, was one site and three months of measuring; wall, he said, is either the brick at the far wall or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ wall I remember is the barrier measured in the plan, which closed in 1969 and is still measured as the quietest in the site. A ⑩ wall, my mother said in 1971, is the only barrier that improves by being measured; every wall, she said, is a protection that has agreed to look like a barrier. She said the protection was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 墙（指工地里每一面旁边的那一面）
B. n. 墙（指那面墙本身，与短短的横梁相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the wall 砌这一面墙
D. n. 墙（指留给孩子们砌的那一块）
E. n. 墙之事（抽象总称，指一处工地的墙之事）
F. n. 墙（指施工图里写到、被测量的那一面）
G. n. 墙、屏障（指一件事里人人都建却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 屏障（抽象总称，指人人都建却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the wall that no assistant in the site would have measured
The wall, meaning the barrier itself and not the beam

answers.why: build the wall 意为“砌这一面墙”，1962 年那位施工员把工地里没有一位帮工肯测量的一面墙做了一遍。
wall 意为“墙”，指那面墙本身而不是短短的横梁，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
wall 意为“墙”，指工地里每一面旁边的那一面，每一面旁边都有同一根短短的横梁。
wall 意为“墙”，指最远那面墙体的留给孩子们砌的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
wall 意为“墙、屏障”，指一件事里人人都建却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这面屏障就是那件事的全部。
wall 意为“屏障”，指人人都建却无人提起的那样东西而不是那面墙，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
wall 意为“墙”，指施工图里写到、被测量的那一面，到 1967 年这一面成了施工图里的一行。
wall 意为“墙之事”，施工员十月写道，整件事的墙之事是一处工地和三个月份的测量。
wall 意为“墙”，我记得的是施工图里测量过的那一面，1969 年建成了，至今仍被说成工地里最安静的一面。
wall 为抽象总称，母亲 1971 年说，墙是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的墙。
